Bill.BriefDescription: Allocating an equal amount of time to gill net gear and purse seine gear to harvest salmon in Puget Sound.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the standardization of salmon fishing time forgill net gear and purse seine gear in Puget Sound; adding a new sectionto chapter 77.50 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the economicwellbeing and stability of the fishing industry and the conservationof the food fish resources of the state of Washington are best servedby allocating an equal amount of time to gill net gear and purse seinegear to harvest salmon in Puget Sound.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.50 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Whenever the commission authorizes commercial fishing forsalmon within the waters described within this chapter, the commissionshall adopt rules specifying weekly fishing schedules for gill net andpurse seine gear that provide: (a) An equal amount of time opened during each week to take salmon;and (b) Alternate first day of the week openings to each gear type. p. 1 HB 3052 (2) Exceptions to this equal time provision may be made only when: (a) Estimates obtained by direct, onwater sampling of each geartype show a disproportionate amount of the bycatch mortality ofincidentally encountered fish or other species associated with fishingby either gear type; (b) Economic analyses of Puget Sound commercial salmon conclusivelydemonstrate that allocating a greater amount of time to either geartype will improve the economic wellbeing and stability of the fishingindustry; or (c) The total allowable harvest, determined by the department onthe basis of either preseason forecast or inseason gatheredinformation, is insufficient to allow openings for both gill net andpurse seine gears. (3) Nothing in this section limits commission authority under RCW77.50.010.
